about: The regression corpus (tools/corpus.py): recorded sessions in the test install's sessions\ (and sessions-2\), by name only. exe = the race.exe it was recorded on (beside the port's dinput.dll). ini = extra viperport.ini settings for its replays. routes = how it must replay IDENTICAL: dll (rewrites), original (MGI's code; never for a session that visits Options), standalone (viperport.exe --race exe). provisional = recorded before the corpus existed; replaced by the fresh set.

sessions.name: sp-stock
sessions.what: single-player race on the stock exe (S1 check; DPI-virtualised 1536x864: race_stock.exe has no HIGHDPIAWARE flag)

sessions.name: vrmod-hornball
sessions.what: vrmod-patched race.exe, hornballs, a Hacks visit (so no original route)

sessions.name: libc-career
sessions.what: LIBC check: menus, career + paint kit saves, 2 races

sessions.name: lan-ai-1
sessions.what: two-copy LAN race with AI cars, copy 1 (host); replayed in the two-copies window it was recorded in

sessions.name: lan-ai-2
sessions.what: two-copy LAN race with AI cars, copy 2, replayed alone in the two-copies window
